factories.name: Dafu Rubber Factory / Feiyue origins
factories.strap: A factory erased; a name that endured
factories.zh: 原大孚橡胶厂：中山西路207号（旧址一带）
factories.description: Changning’s official chronology records the Dafu rubber factory at today’s 207 Zhongshan West Road in July 1931. Later reporting identifies the Shanghai Fire Museum site with the former factory. This is the geography behind the Feiyue story, rather than a surviving production floor.
factories.now: The old industrial site has been redeveloped. The nearby Fire Museum at No. 229 is an orientation landmark, not a footwear museum or factory tour.
factories.visit: Historic-site context only. Confirm museum access separately; no factory access is offered here.
factories.coordNote: Approximate former-site area, anchored to the adjacent Shanghai Fire Museum. It is not a surveyed factory footprint. Amap anchor converted to WGS84.

factories.now: Retail reuse is documented historically. The present tenant, surviving factory fabric and public access still need a site check.

factories.name: Jinbei Shoe Factory → 728 SPACE
factories.strap: The factory as a cultural address
factories.zh: 闵行区颛桥镇光华路728号 忆空间（728 SPACE）
factories.description: Seven 1960s buildings of the former Jinbei shoe factory were retained and strengthened for 728 SPACE. Reporting from its December 2022 opening describes a cultural campus with a public reading room and the Wu Yiren Art Museum.
factories.now: A documented example of factory reuse, well outside the central shopping circuit. Confirm today’s venue programme and access before travelling.
factories.visit: A cultural-site visit, not an operating shoe-factory tour. Allow for a separate trip to Minhang.

routes.name: The Puxi discoveries
routes.description: Four different perspectives on well-made shoes, from a select shop to a collector’s salon and Italian avant-garde. Leave time for fitting rather than trying to see everything.
routes.note: Walk the close sections; use a taxi or metro for longer links. The Anthology lists Tuesday–Sunday hours. Extend north into Jing’an or south to NOOS One ITC if time allows.
